villains.name: Ashardalon, Red Dragon

attacks.damage: 1 and move the Hero 1 tile away from Ashardalon
1, Dazed, and move the Hero to any square adjacent to Ashardalon

tactics: If Ashardalon is adjacent to more than one Hero, Ashardalon attacks each adjacent Hero with a tail sweep.
If Ashardalon is within 1 tile of a Hero, Ashardalon attacks the farthest Hero within 1 tile with a grabbing bite.
Otherwise, Ashardalon moves 1 tile toward the Hero with the most Hit Points.
special_abilities: When Ashardalon is encountered: Find the Ashardalon Breathes! Special Encounter Card and shuffle it into the top 3 cards of the Encounter Card deck.
Squeezing: Ashardalon can be placed over walls, but the center square that his miniature is on must be open.

villains.name: Bellax, Gauth

attacks.damage: 1 and the Hero discards 1 item of his or her choice
1 and move the Hero 1 tile away from the gauth

tactics: If the gauth is adjacent to a Hero, the gauth attacks that Hero with an eye ray and then moves to the closest square not adjacent to a Hero.
If the gauth is within 3 tiles of a Hero, it attacks the Hero with the most Hit Points within range with an eye ray.
Otherwise, the gauth moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero.
special_abilities: Eye Ray: When the gauth attacks with an eye ray, roll the die and consult the table for the attack that is used against the Hero.

villains.name: Karash, Orc Shaman

attacks.damage: 1 and move the Hero 1 tile in the direction of the tile's triangle
1 and move the Hero 1 tile in the direction of the tile's triangle

tactics: If the orc shaman is within 1 tile of a tile with more than 1 Hero, the shaman attacks each Hero on the tile with a primal windstorm.
If the orc shaman is within 1 tile of a single Hero, the shaman attacks the closest Hero with a bolt of lightning.
Otherwise, the orc shaman moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero.

villains.name: Margrath, Duergar Captain

attacks.damage: 1 and move the Hero 1 tile away from the duergar

tactics: If the duergar is adjacent to a Hero, it attacks the Hero with a morning star.
If the duergar is within 1 tile of a Hero, it attacks the Hero with a handful of poisoned quills, and then moves adjacent to that Hero.
Otherwise, the duergar moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero.

villains.name: Meerak, Kobold Dragonlord
tactics: If the kobold is adjacent to a Hero, it attacks that Hero with a short sword, and then the kobold moves to any square within 1 tile.
If the kobold is within 1 tile of a Hero, it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks that Hero with a short sword.
Otherwise, move the kobold 1 tile toward the Hero with the most Hit Points.

villains.name: Otyugh

attacks.damage: 2, Dazed, and move the Hero to any square adjacent to the otyugh

tactics: If the otyugh is adjacent to a Hero, it attacks the adjacent Hero with the most Hit Points remaining with a crushing bite.
If the otyugh is within 2 tiles of a Hero, it attacks that Hero with a grabbing tentacle.
Otherwise, the otyugh moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero.

villains.name: Rage Drake

attacks.damage: 1 and move the Hero 1 tile away from the Rage Drake

tactics: If the rage drake is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it becomes enraged. Flip over this card and consult the tactics section again.
If the rage drake is adjacent to a Hero, it attacks the Hero with a rending bite.
If the rage drake is within 1 tile of a Hero, it moves adjacent to the closest Hero and attacks with a raking charge.
Otherwise, the rage drake moves 1 tile toward the closest Hero.
special_abilities: Enraged form: AC 15, HP 10. Attacks: Claws +10 (2 and move the Hero 2 tiles away from the rage drake), Charge +12 (3 and Dazed). Moves 2 tiles toward closest Hero.

heroes.name: Vistra
heroes.special_ability: CAST-IRON STOMACH: You get a +5 bonus to rolls to end the Poisoned condition.
powers_list: Dwarven Resilience (Dwarf Daily) - Regain 4 Hit Points instead of moving
Charge (Fighter At-Will) - Move up to your speed, then attack one adjacent Monster. +8, 1 damage
Reaping Strike (Fighter At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster twice. +4, 1 damage
Sure Strike (Fighter At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +11, 1 damage
Comeback Strike (Fighter Daily) - Attack one adjacent Monster. If you hit, regain 2 HP. +7, 2 damage
Into the Fray (Fighter Daily) - Place your Hero adjacent to any Hero within 2 tiles. Attack one adjacent Monster. +7, 3 damage (Miss: 1)
Taunting Advance (Fighter Daily) - Move your speed. Choose a Monster within 2 tiles, place it adjacent and attack. +8, 3 damage (Miss: 1)
Inspiring Advice (Fighter Utility) - Reroll a missed attack for any Hero
One for the Team (Fighter Utility) - Resolve an Encounter Card as if you drew it
To Arms! (Fighter Utility) - When a new Monster is placed, you and one Hero on your tile can move your speed

heroes.name: Quinn
heroes.special_ability: SAVING GRACE: When you or any Hero on your tile regains 1 Hit Point or more, that Hero can also end one Condition currently in effect.
powers_list: Healing Hymn (Cleric Utility) - You and one other Hero on your tile regain 2 Hit Points
Cleric's Shield (Cleric At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +6, 1 damage. Choose 1 Hero on your tile gains +2 AC
Righteous Advance (Cleric At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +6, 1 damage. One Hero on your tile moves 2 squares
Sacred Flame (Cleric At-Will) - Attack one Monster within 1 tile. +6, 1 damage. If hit, one Hero gains 1 HP
Blade Barrier (Cleric Daily) - Place 5 Blade Barrier tokens on a tile within 2 tiles. Deal 1 damage to Monsters placed on token squares
Cause Fear (Cleric Daily) - Allies on a tile within 1 tile make At-Will attacks with +2 bonus. Place remaining Monsters within 2 tiles
Wrathful Thunder (Cleric Daily) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +6, 3 damage (Miss: 1). Control a Monster on your tile
Astral Refuge (Utility) - Remove a Hero within 2 tiles, place them on any tile next Hero Phase
Command (Cleric Utility) - Place one Monster on your tile on a tile within 2 tiles of you
Perseverance (Cleric Utility) - Reduce Encounter Card cancel cost by number of Heroes on your tile

heroes.name: Keyleth
heroes.special_ability: HEALING HANDS: When you or any Hero on your tile spends a healing surge, that Hero regains 1 additional Hit Point.
powers_list: Lay on Hands (Paladin Utility) - One adjacent Hero regains 2 hit points
Divine Challenge (Paladin At-Will) - Choose a Monster within 1 tile, place it adjacent. Attack one adjacent Monster. +8, 1 damage
Holy Strike (Paladin At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +8, 1 damage. +1 damage if started adjacent
Valiant Strike (Paladin At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +8, 1 damage. +1 attack per adjacent Monster
Arcing Strike (Paladin Daily) - Attack one or two adjacent Monsters. +9, 3 damage (Miss: 1)
Benign Transposition (Paladin Daily) - Swap with a Hero within 2 tiles, then attack adjacent. +8, 3 damage (Miss: 1)
Righteous Smite (Paladin Daily) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +9, 3 damage (Miss: 1). All Heroes on tile regain 1 HP
Bravery (Paladin Utility) - When Monster within 1 tile activates, place adjacent and regain 1 HP
Noble Shield (Paladin Utility) - Become sole target of multi-Hero attack (auto-hit 20)
Virtue's Touch (Paladin Utility) - End one condition on an adjacent Hero

heroes.name: Tarak
heroes.special_ability: BRUTAL RECOVERY: When you or any Hero on your tile rolls a natural 20, you may recharge (flip over) Furious Assault.
powers_list: Furious Assault (Half-Orc Utility) - When you hit a Monster, it takes +1 damage
Distracting Jab (Rogue At-Will) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +7, 1 damage. If hit, move Monster 1 square. After attack, move your speed
Lucky Strike (Rogue At-Will) - Attack one Monster within 1 tile. +7, 1 damage. Even roll: +1 damage
Positioning Shot (Rogue At-Will) - Attack one Monster within 2 tiles. +7, 1 damage. Place Monster on your tile or adjacent tile
Acrobatic Onslaught (Rogue Daily) - Attack one adjacent Monster. +7, 2 damage (Miss: 1). Then teleport 2 tiles and use At-Will
King's Castle (Rogue Daily) - Swap with a Hero within 1 tile. Attack 1 Monster within 2 tiles. +7, 3 damage (Miss: 1)
Tornado Strike (Rogue Daily) - Attack four times against any Monsters on your tile. +7, 1 damage each
Distant Diversion (Rogue Utility) - Place a Monster within 3 tiles onto an adjacent tile
Practiced Evasion (Rogue Utility) - Negate a Trap or Event Attack hit. Free Disable check if Trap
Tumbling Escape (Rogue Utility) - When hit by a Monster, the attack misses and move 1 tile

heroes.name: Heskan
heroes.special_ability: MAGE HAND: You can open any door on your Hero's tile, not just adjacent doors.
powers_list: Hurled Breath (Dragonborn Daily) - Choose a tile within 2 tiles. Attack each Monster on that tile. +5, 1 damage. Does not count as attack action
Arc Lightning (Wizard At-Will) - Attack up to two Monsters on your tile or within 1 tile. +7, 1 damage
Hypnotism (Wizard At-Will) - Move a Monster within 1 tile 1 tile. If adjacent to another Monster, attack it. +9, 1 damage
Ray of Frost (Wizard At-Will) - Attack one Monster within 2 tiles. +7, 1 damage
Flaming Sphere (Wizard Daily) - Place 3 tokens within 1 tile. Move stack 1 tile instead of moving. Remove token to deal 1 damage to each Monster
Shock Sphere (Wizard Daily) - Choose a tile within 2 tiles. Attack each Monster. +9, 2 damage (Miss: 1)
Spectral Ram (Wizard Daily) - Attack one Monster within 2 tiles. +9, 3 damage (Miss: 1). Place Monster within 2 tiles of start
Invisibility (Wizard Utility) - Until next Hero Phase, don't count as closest Hero for tactics
Mirror Image (Wizard Utility) - Place 3 tokens. +2 AC per token. Remove 1 when Monster misses
Wizard Eye (Wizard Utility) - Place token within 1 tile. Move it instead of moving. Explore from its tile
